frequency_question: How often do final rules published by DHS regarding major visa fee adjustments satisfy specific numerical thresholds (within 10%) without fatal court blocks or withdrawals within the window?
membership_rule: Members are major DHS/USCIS fee-setting final rules published in the Federal Register. Excluded are non-fee rules, minor administrative adjustments, and rules outside the immigration/visa domain.
coverage_note: 5 named major USCIS fee regulation cycles over the period.
known_gaps: Excludes minor fee adjustments not categorized as major USCIS fee rules.
multiplier: 5 hits out of 5 published final rules, though one major 2020 rule faced severe preliminary injunctions; filtering for exact numerical criteria within 10% tolerance
validity_reason: Agency rulemaking procedures and judicial review standards under the APA remain stable through this horizon.
